1. b. The APSDSC will demarcate the required area for the set-up of the labs, and provide the necessary infrastructure as per project specifications outlined in the proposal, including electricity, water, plumbing/ pneumatic piping, furniture, fixtures and adequate security, internet and student training consumables (at actual usage) for the labs.
3. c. APSSDC shall sign the Software License & Services Agreement and other license terms related to use of hardware with SISW and STS respectively and shall abide by those terms. Any use of software license(s) sold to APSSDC shall be in accordance with the terms of the Software License & Services Agreement. All SISW and STS software and hardware sold to APSSDC shall be transferred to CoE's in accordance with the process specified in the Annexure "I".
5. d. In consideration of the above obligations agreed to be undertaken by SISW and DesignTech, APSSDC shall ensure that a total sum of ₹ (INR) 330,00,00,000 (Rupees Three Hundred and Thirty Crores Only) exclusive of applicable taxes, which shall be paid by the Government of AP towards 'Financial assistance'. The amount has been sanctioned vide letter No. ......... Dated .................... The sanction of said amount is subject to the terms and conditions mentioned in the sanction letter. Disbursement of this grant for arranging and installing supplies/equipment as per Annexure I and initiating the project will be released to DesignTech after initiation received from SISW.
7. The above said financial assistance is sanctioned for all capital expenditures, software licenses and any other recurring costs for the project period (acquired and paid) by SISW and DesignTech w.r.t the Project during the operative period, as specified in Clause 4(e) of the Agreement, of the scheme as a one-time grant. No other grant or fees will be provided for any of the project activities to DesignTech or SISW besides the above. Any other licensing fee, professional service charges, renewal fee or any other financial charge if applicable to operate all the supplies and equipments (including the software) provided in the project during the project lifecycle will be borne by DesignTech and/or SISW only. However, the above excludes any cost which APSSDC may have to bear to fulfil its obligations as specified in Clause 6 of the Agreement.
9. DesignTech and SISW hereby agree to comply with all the terms & conditions laid down in this Agreement. Breach of any of the conditions of this Agreement will authorize the state level approval committee and/or APSDSC or GOAP, to take over the Project along with all the assets of the Project and other fixed assets, except other liabilities of SISW, DesignTech, and their promoters and employees.
10. SISW and DesignTech shall assure that the above said financial assistance is utilized in a proper way for the successful implementation of the Project.
11. SISW and DesignTech shall provide progress report on implementation of the Project & utilization certificates of the assistance granted by the GOAP from time to time.

between:

## 7. PAYMENT TERMS AND APPLICABLE TAXES
The amount of ₹ (INR) 330,00,00,000 (Rupees Three Hundred and Thirty Crores Only) exclusive of
applicable taxes to be paid to DesignTech by GOAP, pursuant to this Agreement, will exclude amounts
GOAP is required by law to deduct or withhold. The applicable taxes on such amount shall be borne by
the GOAP.
